Evidence / output: Discover: choose a narrow information task and review actual question categories with a consenting owner.
Scope: declare allowed/prohibited topics, languages, human handoff and recording/retention policy.
Prepare: version the FAQ and select a properly licensed voice with consent evidence.
Build: configure the web-based concierge and knowledge source; add a secure integration only if needed.
Evaluate: run all 20 scenarios; measure task outcome and observed response time, and inspect answer support.
Release: replace placeholders, obtain approval and launch to a limited audience with disclosure and stop/budget controls.
Operate: inspect only consented necessary logs and feedback for seven days; correct failed FAQ paths.
Hand over: document source updates, billing, human contacts, incident response and shutdown.
